cases.name: Leslie Jane Reeves
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Leslie was known for her beautiful smile, living life to the fullest, and helping others.  Her greatest joy was her children and her time with them was the happiest times of her life. Some of Leslie’s favorite hobbies throughout her life were dancing, exercising, art, collecting shoes, travel, cats, and listening to 80s music.

Leslie excelled academically and went from being a proud Kahok to a Miner to a Jayhawk.  After attending Collinsville High where she especially enjoyed being a Kahok cheerleader, she received her Bachelor of Science in Engineering degree from the University of Missouri Rolla.  She then went on to receive her Master of Science in Engineering degree from the University of Kansas.  She worked as a petroleum engineer in the years before she decided to take an opportunity that would allow her to serve others and make a positive impact in her community.  Most recently, she was doing this work through her business, All You Studio & Party Place.

One of Leslie’s favorite songs was “Sweet Child O' Mine” by Guns N' Roses and starts with some fitting lyrics, “She's got a smile that it seems to me reminds me of childhood memories where everything was as fresh as the bright blue sky.”
cases.narrative: On 11/25/2021, her body was found at the apartment of a man she was on a date with. He allegedly shot her once in the head at close range. He shot her date in the head also, but he survived.
